subject.title: feat(canvas): widget design system — theme tokens, base styles, live host theme bridge

question: After the two delivery and contrast fixes, should OpenClaw adopt this new Canvas widget token and classless-style contract as the supported cross-surface design system?
rationale: This PR creates a new agent-facing presentation contract and intentionally changes the appearance of cached legacy widgets, so implementation correctness alone cannot settle the long-term product boundary.

options.title: Adopt after bounded repairs
options.body: Merge after the bridge uses the host primary foreground token and delivers snapshots to every Control UI Canvas iframe.

options.title: Narrow to fallback styling
options.body: Keep baked fallback styles but defer the live host-token contract until its supported surfaces and compatibility expectations are explicitly defined.

recommendation.title: Adopt after bounded repairs
recommendation.body: Merge after the bridge uses the host primary foreground token and delivers snapshots to every Control UI Canvas iframe.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed Canvas contract and supplied the relevant live proof; ownership evidence is otherwise limited.
